Castlevania was distributed as a paid-only game from the PlayStation Family Software and was officially released by Game Industries in 1994. The game was designed to allow players play Castlevania 5 on different platforms and allow players to run a prominent entry in the series. This game was set with a Castlevania of the infamous English American trademark for the PlayStation Family.

It was the first to offer English-speaking localization.[10] The game was expanded with several items, including puzzle selection, and enhanced graphics.
